summary: Deployed branch_stock on node1 using RHEL 9 PostgreSQL 13. stock_app and auditor have separate SCRAM credentials on node2 and the requested least-privilege access. Source records, RHEL 9.8, and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8 were preserved. Both nodes passed sequential restart and recovery verification.
actions_performed: Installed distribution-supported PostgreSQL 13 server on node1 and client on node2.
Imported the supplied stock.sql schema and all four records into branch_stock.
Created distinct SCRAM credentials with root-only credential files on node2.
Restricted PostgreSQL authentication and firewalld access to node2.
Verified allowed and denied operations for both roles.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities and complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: branch_stock contains the supplied schema and records
evidence.summary: Captured the original SQL and checksum, imported both tables and four rows, and confirmed final records LABELS:18:1.75 and PAPER:40:3.25 with the unchanged source checksum.

evidence.requirement: stock_app can read stock and update quantities only
evidence.summary: Proved stock reads and a transactional quantity update; supplier_costs reads, schema creation, and SKU updates were denied. Final catalog checks confirm the precise column privileges.

evidence.requirement: auditor has read-only access to stock and supplier_costs
evidence.summary: Proved reads of both tables, denied stock updates, and confirmed the final grants.

evidence.requirement: Roles use separate protected credentials from node2
evidence.summary: Confirmed separate mode-600 credential files survived restart, password hashes are distinct SCRAM secrets, and HBA rules restrict both roles to node2.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel were preserved
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on RHEL 9.8 with kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8 after deployment and restart.
